**Introduction**
This analysis explores Lego sets over the years to see how the number of sets produced has grown over time.

**Data Sources:**
- [TidyTuesday Lego Sets](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/master/data/2022/2022-09-06/readme.md)
- Original Data: [Rebrickable](https://rebrickable.com/downloads/)

**Analysis**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load data
lego_sets <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2022/2022-09-06/sets.csv.gz')

# count sets per year
sets_per_year <- lego_sets |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(total_sets = n())

ggplot(data = sets_per_year, aes(x = year, y = total_sets)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Lego Sets over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Sets"
  )
```
